name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling inducing type I interferon
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 sensing, TRAF3/TRAF6-driven IRF and NF-kB activation and its viral modulation; unlike the confusables (cytosolic DNA sensing, ISG15, OAS, type III IFN) the theme carries positive regulation of interferon-alpha/beta production and the antiviral IFN signature.

core: Antigen receptor signaling with co-stimulation and co-inhibition
name: T and B cell antigen receptor signaling and co-regulation
rationale: Members are TCR proximal signaling, CD28 co-stimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition; the B cell receptor members (BCR signaling, CD22, BTK, negative regulation of BCR) distinguish it from the T-cell-only confusables.

core: Motor behavior and its neural development
name: Cerebellar and basal ganglia development and motor behavior
rationale: Members span cerebellar layer and glial development, striatum and substantia nigra development, motor neuron survival, locomotion, proprioception and motor learning, whereas confusables are brainstem, pons and respiratory-control centred.

core: Ribosome biogenesis and rRNA transcription control
name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and rRNA transcription control
rationale: Members concern regulation of ribosome biogenesis, Pol I rRNA repression and nucleolar chromatin, plus MYC target programmes and methionine sensing, which distinguish it from confusables built on Pol I initiation machinery.

core: Proteasome-dependent MHC class I antigen processing
name: Proteasome, MHC class I processing and HIV receptor downregulation
rationale: Members combine proteasome structure/assembly, class I antigen processing and Nef/Vpu-mediated degradation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I; confusables lack either the proteasome core or the HIV downregulation members.

core: Glial cell fate, proliferation and differentiation
name: Glial cell fate, proliferation and reactive astrocyte regulation
rationale: Members regulate glial fate, proliferation, migration and astrocyte/oligodendrocyte differentiation; astrocyte migration, astrocyte activation and reactive gliosis distinguish it from the myelin-focused confusables.

name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are face, palate, nose and cranium morphogenesis plus fore/hindlimb and digit morphogenesis; limb members distinguish it from confusables that add pharyngeal-derived glands, ear or ossification.

qualifier: by RNA polymerase II and III
name: snRNA gene transcription by RNA polymerase II and III
rationale: Members cover Pol III initiation from type 3 (snRNA-type) promoters, elongation and termination, and Pol II snRNA transcription; confusables are tRNA-type Pol III promoters or spliceosome assembly.

core: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and translation
name: Stress granule control of mRNA stability and translation
rationale: Members are RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stabilization/decay and translational silencing alongside stress granule assembly, PKR and arsenite stress; confusables are ARE-decay (TTP, KSRP, BRF1) and P-body decay without the stress granule and translational-silencing members.

name: Cardiac contractility and stress-induced striated muscle remodeling
rationale: Members regulate heart rate, contraction force and relaxation together with cardiac adaptation, sarcomere growth, hypertrophy and fiber-type transition; confusables lack the hypertrophy/adaptation members and lean on calcium pumping or negative chronotropy.

name: Epithelial salt transport and cellular osmotic stress response
rationale: Members cover cation-chloride cotransporters and their tubulopathies, renal sodium and potassium transport and chloride secretion; hyper/hypotonic and salt-stress responses and water homeostasis distinguish it from confusables.

core: ER protein targeting and COPII export
name: ER membrane protein insertion and COPII export
rationale: Members are SRP-dependent and tail-anchored/multi-pass insertion into the ER membrane plus COPII cargo loading and ER-to-Golgi transport; confusables instead add COPI retrograde traffic, ER folding and ERAD.

core: Nuclear pore complex assembly, disassembly and transport
name: Nuclear pore complex dynamics and inositol phosphate transport
rationale: Members are NPC assembly, disassembly, postmitotic reformation and pore-mediated transport; inositol phosphate and Rev transport distinguish it from nuclear-envelope and mRNA-export confusables.

name: Peroxisomal lipid metabolism and cholesterol biosynthesis
rationale: Members span peroxisomal VLCFA oxidation/synthesis, plasmalogen and ether lipid synthesis and peroxisome protein import, plus mevalonate-to-cholesterol synthesis, which none of the confusables contain.

name: T cell immunological synapse, adhesion and chemokine-directed migration
rationale: Members cover synapse formation, T cell polarity, raft localization, aggregation and adhesion; chemokine receptor and integrin-activation members distinguish it from confusables.

name: Keratinocyte growth, differentiation and migration in wound healing
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis and migration and epidermal wound spreading, whereas confusables are cornification/skin barrier or inflammatory wound responses.

name: Fructose and glucuronate-xylulose pentose metabolism
rationale: Members are fructose catabolism and its disorders plus glucuronate-to-xylulose-5-phosphate metabolism (pentosuria); confusables are galactose and pentose phosphate shunt pathways or polyols.

name: Taste and smell chemosensory perception
rationale: Members cover all five taste modalities and their receptors plus odorant and pheromone perception; confusables have only one of taste or smell plus unrelated development or channel terms.

name: Oligodendrocyte differentiation and central nervous system myelination
rationale: Members are oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and differentiation, CNS myelin formation/maintenance and glial proliferation; spinal oligodendrocyte and positive myelination members distinguish it from astrocyte- and PNS-centred confusables.

name: Non-canonical Wnt signaling and CNS vascular barrier formation
rationale: Members are WNT5A/Ca2+ signaling and FZD internalization plus retinal vasculature, retinal pigment epithelium and blood-brain/retinal barrier formation; confusables lack either the Wnt/Ca2+ members or the barrier and retinal vascular members.

name: Ubiquitin chain assembly, deubiquitination and proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members cover E1/E2/E3 and linkage-specific ubiquitination, the deubiquitinase families and proteasome assembly and degradation; confusables are neddylation/COP9 or misfolded protein quality control and autophagy.

name: Glycosylation substrate transport and sialic acid metabolism
rationale: Members are nucleotide-sugar and related Golgi/ER substrate transporters (SLC35, SLC33A1, SLC26A2) and their diseases plus sialic acid and amino sugar metabolism; confusables add GDP-fucose, UDP-GlcNAc synthesis or N-glycan/GPI processing instead.

name: Vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and isoprenoid quinone biosynthesis
rationale: Members are vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors plus mevalonate/prenyl diphosphate synthesis feeding quinones; confusables are vitamin D, vitamin E or cholesterol synthesis.

name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and bacterial killing
rationale: Members regulate NADPH oxidase superoxide and hydrogen peroxide production and the phagocyte respiratory burst; neutrophil degranulation and antibacterial killing distinguish it from confusables.

name: Noncoding RNA methylation and snRNP/snoRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members are rRNA/tRNA/snRNA methylation and modification with snoRNP assembly and scaRNA localization; snRNP assembly, cap hypermethylation and snRNA transport distinguish it from diphthamide and pseudouridylation confusables.
